loop.body: Pick one concept I can't explain yet: schema linking, SHAP, tool-calling loops.
Build something real with it, with Claude Code as pair-programmer and me making the calls.
Push it to GitHub with tests, a write-up and the numbers, good or bad.

about.manifesto: I got into AI through automation: n8n agents, RPA bots and data pipelines that teams relied on daily. Now I’m going deeper on the models behind them.

experience.role: Executive, Supply Chain Management & Automation Operations
points: Built and owned live automation systems processing high-volume orders across multiple seller portals (Walmart DSV, Shein), improving accuracy, throughput and reliability.
Developed automated data pipelines and SQL reporting tools that turned operational data into actionable insight on shipping variance and shipper performance.
Solved a hard integration gap by building RPA-driven automation for Amazon Seller Central workflows not covered by the SP-API, removing manual handling of high-volume processes.
Debugged, optimised and scaled automation systems with cross-functional teams, quickly learning unfamiliar codebases to improve reliability and performance.
experience.summary: Built and ran live automation, SQL reporting tools and RPA for high-volume e-commerce operations, including the workflows no official API covered.

points: Designed and deployed AI agent workflows using n8n to automate tasks across departments, turning stakeholder requirements into working, maintainable tools.
Built automated report generation from databases and Excel, delivering accurate, timely output to support data-driven decisions.
Implemented RPA tools to eliminate repetitive manual tasks, improving data quality and saving employee time.
